description: Build section due North at 3°/100 ft, surveys every 100 ft, 0° at MD 0 to 60° at MD 2,000 ft. Published minimum-curvature result at 2,000 ft: TVD = 1,653.99 ft, North = 954.93 ft (compared here in metres).
source: Bourgoyne, A.T., Millheim, K.K., Chenevert, M.E. & Young, F.S. (1991), Applied Drilling Engineering, SPE Textbook Series Vol. 2 — as tabulated in Amorin, R. & Broni-Bediako, E. (2010), Application of Minimum Curvature Method to Wellpath Calculations, Proc. 1st Biennial UMaT Int. Conf. on Mining & Mineral Processing, Tarkwa, Ghana, pp. 524-541 (Table B / Table 1.5)
source_check: Values read from the Amorin & Broni-Bediako (2010) PDF (UMaT repository) on 2026-10-18; the Bourgoyne original was not consulted directly.
tolerance_justification: Published values are rounded to 0.01 ft, so the reference is only known to ±0.005 ft (= 0.001524 m). No further allowance.
